objective_contribution: Complete the GLM-5.3-flash 8K evidence denominator without wasting later model tokens after a fully accounted local outcome and without weakening shared integrity stops.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Can an explicit fully accounted local outcome taxonomy plus immediate durable receipts reach the full exposed denominator without weakening shared integrity stops?

measurement_mapping.native: Only complete paired native scores estimate evidence-selection usefulness; explicit empty selections derive zero and failed cells remain missing in the full denominator.
measurement_mapping.retention: Confirmed delivery, displacement, exact state presentation and independently scored later evidence use remain required.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Verify typed terminal evidence, complete model accounting, result identity, ancestry, no rerun, immediate local-failure receipt and global shared stops.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count every model input and output token in prefixes, completed branches, failed branches, corrections and terminal requests under 96,000.
measurement_mapping.transfer: The taxonomy is reusable infrastructure, but one exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K round cannot establish larger-window, model, domain, correctness or confirmation transfer.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: Finish the GLM small-window chapter before larger windows, other models, or domains.
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Same exposed eight-task cohort. Round 19 is immutable historical evidence. Reserved confirmation remains untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: No tuning, replacement, source refresh, prompt/cap/threshold/state/scorer change or favorable rerun. Only the enumerated failure taxonomy and immediate ledger may change.

retained_counterevidence: Round 19 stopped after 17 of 56 cells, leaving 39 unstarted.
Four complete pairs had mean span F1 delta +0.1874, file F1 delta +0.0333 and model-token delta -20,644.5.
One of four span pairs and one of four file pairs favored control.
The first local tokenizer timeout was retained and independent cells continued.
A later HTTP-200 tool-calls-invalid response had 73,155 known model tokens and zero unknown usage but stopped the sequence.
The accepted tokenizer failure was absent from a durable sequence ledger after the later stop.
H25 remains decision-ineligible; repair correctness, transfer, confirmation and clearance remain unproved.
successor_rule: Prove the typed classifier and immediate ledger offline, then freeze and run every Round 20 identity once. Retain local failures and continue independent cells; any unknown or shared failure stops. Review H31 separately from H25. Every successor passes policy v4 exact-value continuity.

criterion_verdicts.enduring_objective: The selected mechanism preserves more usable evidence per cumulative model token by preventing local failures from censoring later cells.
criterion_verdicts.initial_GLM_objective: GLM-5.3-flash remains at the 8K small-window chapter.
criterion_verdicts.current_milestone: The fixed full ContextBench contract remains unchanged and uncleared; the immediate gate is the exposed 24-pair denominator.
criterion_verdicts.method_and_predecessor: Reviewed Round 19 evidence yields competing H31, H30, H25 and H0; H31 addresses the observed classifier and durability gaps.
criterion_verdicts.counterevidence: Incomplete coverage, heterogeneous effects, both failure classes and the missing ledger remain explicit.
criterion_verdicts.measurement_and_token_cost: Failure isolation, native quality, retention, integrity, transfer and every model input/output token remain separate.
criterion_verdicts.scope_and_acceptance: The same exposed cohort remains separate from reserved confirmation and the full 1,136-identity acceptance run.
criterion_verdicts.testability: Exact error families, receipt fields, immediate persistence, replay, unknown-usage rejection and shared-stop controls directly falsify H31.
